title: Linguistic Minimal Pair Testing Borrowed from Phonology

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Improving the rigor of circuit analysis methodology has indirect safety impact through better mechanistic interpretability. A systematic catalog of circuit sensitivity to linguistic variation would strengthen the evidential basis for safety-relevant circuit claims.
